description: A Perl script (afblue.pl) that processes a blue zone character data file, parsing sections, strings, blocks, and handling preprocessor directives to generate data structures for the FreeType project.

methods.name: Warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message with file and line number context.

methods.name: Die
methods.description: Outputs an error message with file and line number context and terminates execution.

methods.name: warn_before
methods.description: Warns about data before the first section if not warned before.

methods.name: strip_newline
methods.description: Removes trailing newline and carriage return characters from the current input line.

methods.name: end_curr_string
methods.description: Finalizes the current string, appending null terminator if needed, and updates offsets.

methods.name: update_max_elem_size
methods.description: Updates the maximum element size for the current section.

methods.name: convert_non_ascii_char
methods.description: Converts a non-ASCII character outside printable range to hex escape sequence.

methods.name: convert_ascii_chars
methods.description: Converts a series of ASCII printable characters to a comma-separated list.

methods.name: convert_literal
methods.description: Converts a string literal to a safe escaped form, handling non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: aux_name
methods.description: Generates a unique auxiliary variable name based on section count and name stack.

methods.name: aux_name_next
methods.description: Generates the next auxiliary variable name by incrementing the top of the name stack.

methods.name: enum_val_string
methods.description: Creates a string representing an enum value assignment for the current offset.

methods.name: emit_diversion
methods.description: Replaces template placeholders with corresponding data from diversions.
